(1) the text-based summarization method performs better than the other methods in all cases, (2) the audio-video summarization performs worse than all other methods in all three cases, (3) the image-based summarization method does not do well in any case, and (4) the image-based method is not as effective as the text-based methods.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best method for summarizing a presentation depends on the type of user and the type of information they are looking for.
the audio-video summarization techniques we developed outperformed the text/image only methods in terms of both user performance and preference.
the best text/image summarization techniques outperform audio/video techniques, and the worst text/image techniques perform worse than audio/video techniques.
